accepted_scope: Current Goody_Hut1, Bonuses4, Congress12 and Refund12 wire value codecs, actual-definition overlays and structural first-player indexing to Cities; not complete Player state or lifecycle.
semantics_reviewed: Ordered hash/value wire entries retain unknown keys and duplicates.
Actual DefinitionLookup drives overlays; later mapped pairs win.
Goody Read preserves existing values and omitted applying flag.
Bonuses concrete Reset explicitly zeros before overlay.
Congress resize preserves known prefix; unsupplied growth fails rather than inventing values.
Congress GovernmentSlot vector is positional; each Refund independently carries version12.
Omitted Congress runtime fields stay owner inputs, with no planning-only exclusion.
Count/byte checks and fallible reservations bound component allocations; Limits is not an aggregate heap cap.
limitations: Two original normalization streams share one initial context; they do not establish gameplay branch diversity.
All observed original Refund vectors are empty; the two-record nonempty Refund carrier is source-derived synthetic evidence only.
Current-only codecs intentionally reject older versions and noncanonical encodings.
Active definition mappings and omitted runtime state remain required for value application.
Archive/dirty effects, complete Player/City codecs, complete Unit roster and gameplay actions/turns remain unsupported.
